title: Value Betting and Denial
description:
There are three different situations with respect to value betting. Equity and Urgency determine in which situation we are in.

Must Value Bet

When your hand is strong enough to pick a certain bet size.
AND
Urgency is high.

Optional Value Bet

When your hand is strong enough to pick a certain bet size.
AND
Urgency is NOT high.

You Cannot Value Bet

When your hand is not strong enough to pick any bet size.
OR
You are not building a betting range using a sizing small enough to value bet your hand.

Denial

Denyinh equity to livew hands your opponent has to fold is a useful bonus but not a sufficient reason for betting by itself. Denial comes in handy when the fold equity is largely useful to you.(Flop and turn) Lower pairs require more protection than the higher pairs.

title: Mental Models
description:
A mental model is an internal explanation of how something works in the real world. It shapes our perceptions, reasoning, and decision-making mechanisms.

By building a 'latticework' of mental models across discipline boundaries—such as inversion, opportunity cost, and first principles—individuals can make clearer, objective assessments of complex problems.
